function.arguments: {"observation": "The `arm` and `severity` distributions are highly imbalanced: the treatment group has 95 severe cases, while the control group has only 21. This violates the assumption of comparability between arms, as the data dictionary explicitly states that treatment was assigned by clinician judgement and that sicker patients were preferentially given treatment.", "implication": "A raw comparison of response rates between arms would be confounded by severity. The observed difference in response rates would reflect both treatment effect and severity imbalance. To estimate the true treatment effect, we must adjust for severity — either by stratifying, standardising, or modelling it. Failing to do so risks reporting a biased or even reversed effect."}
function.name: note_finding
